## Historical audit: S0137

**Scope.** This is chunk 2 of 2; the other chunk and the referenced images are not visible here. All citations below refer to S0137, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/generic_rsi/C2/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Goal and build — line 19, `model_request`, characters [0,136385) | The requested goal was a single-photo indoor reconstruction, matching camera, framing, occlusions, materials and separate meshes. The student’s code represents a kitchen with architecture, cabinet, blinds, counter, sink, towel fixture, blender, jug and pitcher. These object identities are the student’s interpretation, not independently verified image contents. |
| Geometry and finish — line 19, `model_request`, [0,136385) | Code includes framed cabinet panels, blind slats and gaps, a dark sink surface and rim, holder supports and pitcher handles; towel meshes and a label are parented to assemblies. It uses procedural granite and cloth textures, colored materials, camera and area lights. Grouping and intended supports do not establish physical connection, contact or correct pose. |
| Revision — line 19, `model_request`, [0,136385) | After step 1, the student estimated inadequate occupancy and changed lens 47→63 and camera shift, while also moving objects, enlarging the sink, darkening materials and reducing light. After step 2, it diagnosed leftward displacement and excessive brightness, then changed horizontal shift .23→.17 and exposure to −.55. These are student visual assessments, not independent measurements. |
| Validation and selection — line 19, `model_request`, [0,136385); line 21, `model_response`, [0,349); line 22, `select`, [0,59) | Runner feedback reports `ok: true` and `render_available` for all three executions, with saved renders. With no executions remaining, the student responded `SELECT 3`; the selection event records step 3. This establishes execution and selection, not visual or geometric correctness. |
| Guidance and exploration — line 19, `model_request`, [0,136385); line 20, `codex_session`, [0,4303) | The student received system and runner instructions to compare renders and make narrow corrections; its subsequent code visibly implements its own framing and tone choices. No distinct teacher diagnosis or teacher-proposed update appears in this visible chunk, so teacher receipt or adoption cannot be established. The final read-only CLI session reports zero tool calls; earlier code and render feedback show iterative exploration within the runner, not independent external exploration. |

**Outcome and uncertainty.** Formal execution succeeded and step 3 was selected; reconstruction quality is **unknown**, not a demonstrated visual success or algorithm failure. No technical interruption or empty patch is shown. Image paths and student claims cannot verify object coverage, silhouettes, occlusion, pose, material appearance, lighting, or whether parts actually meet. In particular, the hypothesized framing and brightness improvements remain unverified here.

**Lessons.** Transferable: distinguish a render becoming available from a validated match, and separate camera-wide hypotheses from local geometry changes. Task-specific: this student’s chosen kitchen assemblies, landmark estimates, lens shifts and darkening are hypotheses about this particular reference, not generally established solutions.
